Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: My School 5.3 Care for my school environment (10 lessons) By the end of the Sub 
Topic 5.4: Safety in the School environment
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 10

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Safety in the School environment, part of My School 5.3 Care for my school environment (10 lessons) By the end of the Sub  in SNE  /  visual-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: Why do you observe safety? 2. How should we behave when we meet strangers?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Safety in the School environment together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Digital literacy: learner manipulates digital devices to watch video clips showing dangerous places, objects and activities.

Values:
• Love: as learner works harmoniously with other learners in groups.

• Responsibility: learner develops discipline when cleaning working areas after an activity

48

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Safety and security: learner enhances safety and security when able to identify strangers and knowing what to do when in contact with a

stranger.

• Disaster and risk reduction: learner identifies safe places and activities in the school.

Link to other learning area:

Safety issues can be reinforced when learners carry out stretches in Creative Activities.

Suggested Learning Resources

Video clips, audio clips, local environment, environmental natural and man-made structures, school environment.
